versions.changelog:
sn-ppt-workbench v2026.8.19

- New detailed SKILL.md added, clarifying usage, invocation, rules, and environment setup for the AI PPT editing Workbench.
- Strictly enforces editing only existing HTML-based decks—no style, outline, or export generation.
- Automatic detection of the latest usable deck when no path is provided; requests for manual path entry if none found.
- Documents full command-line invocation patterns, cross-platform handling, and advanced bridge/authentication setups.
- Outlines clear error reporting, LAN/remote access guidance, and hard usage rules for safety and reliability.
